comment: He is an entertaining and approachable professor. He is not the easiest grader but his feedback does make sense. He is very accessible outside of class and pays attention to effort and growth. His exams and tests aren't too complicated, but can be difficult if you don't understand the readings completely.
10/10 there is a lot of reading for this course but he keeps it interesting and fun. the exams and papers are a fun time because they relate to real-world congressional processes.

He is literally the best! Every class is so interesting and fun. You get to hear from cool speakers (former inspector generals and governors) and have open dialogue. The reading is not too bad and grading criteria are clear. Anyone who wants to learn about government should take this class!

Dr. Palazzolo was wonderful! He did assign a good amount of reading and some of it could be pretty boring but it was all useful for class. Participation is huge and he keeps track of who participates as well. If you study and do the reading, this class will be a breeze.

Dr. Palazzolo is such an amazing professor! He is very kind and knowledgable. Definitely take his class. There is a lot of reading but the readings are interesting and helpful. People say that he is a tough grader but I think he is very fair. As long as you try you will do well in this class.

Dr. Palazzolo is really smart and really funny. If you put in the work, he will make the class worthwhile for you. Do the readings and absolutely don't be afraid to speak in class. He loves participation and is funny asf. Ask him to do Bernie impression. Can tell if you don't try on papers.

Dr. Palazzolo is one of the best professors at UR. Highly knowledgeable, experienced, and charismatic. Classes generally follow a "read, think, write, discuss" format. Attending office hours is highly recommended, as he is a tough grader but only does so because he *knows* you can be better and thus pushes you to do so. Would definitely recommend!

Dr. Palazzolo is an amazing professor and a great guy. Homework is manageable. He is a really tough grader on the papers, but he is always open and accessible to students. Responds to emails very quickly. Overall, I highly recommend taking a class with him, but you will definitely need to work for your grade. He is not an easy A - but worth it.

Palazzolo's very nice & approachable. He guides class discussions well but him rambling got very boring at times. I wish there was more collaboration & vibrancy, something I looked forward to. I didn't do any of the readings & was fine because we went over them in class. We had 3 papers, 2 tests, & 1 final. I definitely improved my writing level.

Pretty nice guy, can definitely tell he's knowledgable about American government/politics in general. Very tough grader and doesn't give the clearest guidelines of what he would like to see. He values participation a lot and can be easily contacted outside of class for help if needed.
He's super kind and understanding.  He will give extensions if you need. He is a tough grader on the response papers but hes a great teacher.

Dr. Palazzolo is *the* best political science professor you will find for first-years. Classes are engaging, his expertise and knowledge are extensive, and he's a great guy to be around. He's a big proponent of free and open discussion. I cannot speak more highly of Dr. P - he's truly outstanding. 5 stars from me, and it isn't even close!

Palazzolo is a good teacher who is very knowledgable about politics. I took his 2 unit Legislative Internship class, which involves a huge paper which takes up the majority of your time. While I did learn quite a bit in this class, he is a very difficult grader which can make the class take a toll on your GPA. Overall good teacher but tough grader.
Super engaging, passionate about the material, effective teacher, understanding

Dr. Palazzolo was hands down my favorite professor of my first semester. I would definitely  recommend taking a class with him. Lots of reading and a few papers. Not an easy A; however,  this is a very rewarding and interesting class. Palazzolo genuinely cares about his students, is incredibly knowledgeable, and is very accessible outside of class.

Dan Palazzolo is a great professor, he is interesting and makes budget politics interesting. There is a good amount of reading and a couple of papers, but nothing that was too bad. Definitely see him during office hours for help on papers.
He's the best professor one could ever have. If you are a political science student then definitely take his class. If you're not, then still you should take his class. He's the best!

Incredible teacher, this guy knows his stuff! If you are interested in a poli sci major, take as many classes with him as you can, there is plenty of homework and essays are very hard, but if you meet with him, he will help you a lot, don't take if you want an easy a....

Dr. Palazzolo is an amazing professor! I always looked forward to his class and he managed to make everything interesting. He was super helpful with every paper too! I hope I can take another class with him.

This man is awesome.  I cannot wait to take another one of his classes.  The papers were sometimes challenging, but he made it very clear what he expected from them.  You could tell he cared so much because he was always interesting and engaging.  He wanted the class to be as interactive as possible.  I will genuinely miss going to his class!

Phenomenal professor. He is absolutely brilliant in his field, and you can tell how passionate he is about teaching. Very funny and accessible outside of class...one of the best professors at UR, no question!

Dan the Man. Had him for Democracy and the Deficit. He is funny, interesting and very forthcoming and helpful. He made a class about fiscal policy as interesting as it could be. He is a hard grader, but he will teach you how to write papers at the collegiate   level. Also has many connections, very good at getting students internships.

Great teacher:chill,relaxed and funny.You might be dissappointed with your first few paper grades.But go to him for help and he will tell you what he wants.Submit rough drafts,they're very helpful.Read the books and participate.He is fair and has good idea of the effort you put in and rewards you accordingly.If you put in the work you will do well.

Palazzolo is a great teacher.  He is a tough grader when it comes to writing papers but he makes it crystal clear as to what he expects.  An A is certainly possible in his classes and he truly wants to award A's to all his students.  Highly recommended.

Dr. Palazzolo is amazing. His class is challenging...but he really cares about how his students are doing and making sure we understand the class material. He's a great lecturer...and makes discussions extremely interesting. I will DEFINITELY take him again!!
Great teacher, very smart and interesting, I would take him again  in a heartbeat. I love the way he talks.
Great professor! Very interesting and makes the class enjoyable. He is a bit tough on grading papers but no tests throughout the semester and a take home final.
funny and fair
No Comments
One of the best professors at Richmond.  One of the few classes that I never skipped.  Great guy.
Smart, fun.
